arguments.command:
cd /work/ProbabilityTheoryFormalization && perl -0pi -e 's/simpa only \[measureCdf, ProbabilityTheory\.cdf_eq_real\] using
    ProbabilityTheory\.tendsto_cdf_atBot \(μ : Measure ℝ\)/rw [show measureCdf μ = (fun x => ProbabilityTheory.cdf (μ : Measure ℝ) x) by
    funext x; exact cdf_eq μ x]
  exact ProbabilityTheory.tendsto_cdf_atBot (μ : Measure ℝ)/; s/simpa only \[measureCdf, ProbabilityTheory\.cdf_eq_real\] using
    ProbabilityTheory\.tendsto_cdf_atTop \(μ : Measure ℝ\)/rw [show measureCdf μ = (fun x => ProbabilityTheory.cdf (μ : Measure ℝ) x) by
    funext x; exact cdf_eq μ x]
  exact ProbabilityTheory.tendsto_cdf_atTop (μ : Measure ℝ)/; s/simpa only \[measureCdf, ProbabilityTheory\.cdf_eq_real\] using
    ProbabilityTheory\.monotone_cdf \(μ : Measure ℝ\)/rw [show measureCdf μ = (fun x => ProbabilityTheory.cdf (μ : Measure ℝ) x) by
    funext x; exact cdf_eq μ x]
  exact ProbabilityTheory.monotone_cdf (μ : Measure ℝ)/; s/simpa only \[measureCdf, ProbabilityTheory\.cdf_eq_real\] using
    \(ProbabilityTheory\.cdf \(μ : Measure ℝ\)\)\.right_continuous x/rw [show measureCdf μ = (fun y => ProbabilityTheory.cdf (μ : Measure ℝ) y) by
    funext y; exact cdf_eq μ y]
  exact (ProbabilityTheory.cdf (μ : Measure ℝ)).right_continuous x/' ProbabilityTheory/chapter_10/thm_10_8_support.lean
PATH=/opt/lean/bin:$PATH lake env lean ProbabilityTheory/chapter_10/thm_10_8_support.lean
